title: 几款百元内公路自行车开口外胎使用感受
notes: Owner comparison (2025-05-30) of four sub-CNY 100 clinchers: Continental Ultra Sport 3 28C 280 g, CST C1808 28C 260 g, JILUER Chaser 60 TPI 28C 250 g (CNY 85), Goodyear Eagle Sport 28C 280 g. JILUER felt fastest and most comfortable but had the least grip; CST C1808 rated most puncture- and wear-resistant.
